description: LLM+TPE hybrid schedules for Option 2 Stage 2 (apply with a fixed prompt variant). mix_sweep is 30/70 through 70/30 (H1, H40, H0, H60, H2). selector_sweep is UCB/PUCB (wired, not launched).

variants.label: mix50
variants.notes: Current default after warm-start.

variants.label: mix20
variants.notes: P16 mix sweep: 20% LLM / 80% TPE after warm-start.

variants.label: mix40
variants.notes: P16 mix sweep: 40% LLM / 60% TPE after warm-start.

variants.label: mix70
variants.notes: 70% LLM / 30% TPE after warm-start.

variants.label: mix60
variants.notes: 60% LLM / 40% TPE after warm-start.

variants.label: phase20_tpe
variants.notes: Trials 0-19 LLM (after warm-start still applies), then 100% TPE.

variants.label: phase40_tpe
variants.notes: Trials 0-39 LLM (4 warm-start + 36 with history), then trials 40-79 100% TPE.

variants.label: phase5_tpe
variants.notes: Trials 0-4 LLM warm-start only, then 100% TPE.

variants.label: phase15_tpe
variants.notes: Trials 0-14 LLM, then 100% TPE.

variants.label: phase25_tpe
variants.notes: Trials 0-24 LLM, then 100% TPE.

variants.label: ucb
variants.notes: Two-arm UCB, C=1.4, Q=last-10 min-max. Not launched.

variants.label: pucb_window
variants.notes: CoFEH PUCB, C2=1.4, LLM prior 0.9→0.1, Q=window min-max. Not launched.

variants.label: pucb_breakthrough
variants.notes: PUCB with CoFEH breakthrough-rate Q. Not launched.

variants.label: pucb_arm_best
variants.notes: PUCB with arm-best Q. LLM prior 0.9→0.1.

variants.label: pucb_arm_best_p08
variants.notes: PUCB arm-best Q. LLM ω 0.8→0.2. Pair with P5plusA5T50X50RS10.

variants.label: pucb_arm_best_p07
variants.notes: PUCB arm-best Q. LLM ω 0.7→0.3. Pair with P5plusA5T50X50RS10.

variants.label: pucb_arm_best_end05
variants.notes: PUCB arm-best Q. LLM ω 0.9→0.5, TPE ω 0.1→0.5 so LLM still runs after trial 50 when P5+ this-run/fANOVA can enter. Tilts the WHOLE schedule, not late-only.

variants.label: pucb_arm_best_late_floor05
variants.notes: Same 0.9→0.1 PUCB decay as HPUCB_arm until ~trial 50 (frac 0.6 of adaptive budget), then clamp ω_llm≥0.5. Pair with P5plusA5TRdyFanovaX50 so Fanova-filtered prompts actually get late LLM turns. Does not overwrite HPUCB_arm or HPUCB_arm_p05.

variants.label: pucb_arm_then_mix50
variants.notes: HPUCB_arm for the first ~40 trials (frac 0.47 of adaptive budget, same 0.9→0.1 decay as shipping), then Bernoulli 50/50 (H0) for trials 41–80. Sequential splice of the two-run portfolio idea. Pair with P5plusA5T50X50. Does not overwrite HPUCB_arm.

variants.label: discounted_thompson
variants.notes: Discounted Thompson: Beta(S+1,F+1), gamma=0.95 on both arms each trial. Reward = beat incumbent.

variants.label: adaptive_pursuit
variants.notes: Adaptive pursuit P_min=0.2 beta=0.3 on window min-max Q. LLM floor 20% matches mix-grid / Part C.

variants.label: discounted_ucb
variants.notes: Garivier D-UCB on discounted incumbent-beat rewards, C=1.4, gamma=0.95.

variants.label: ucb_page_hinkley
variants.notes: UCB1 + Page-Hinkley restart when the reward stream changes.

variants.label: llinbo_transient
variants.notes: LLINBO-Transient: p_LLM = clip(8/t, 0.1, 0.9). Scheduled decay, not learned. Contrast arm vs H2.
